Profile means, variances and covariances of an LPA or a continuous LTA

profilemeans.Rd

Profile means, variances and covariances of an LPA or a continuous LTA

Usage

profilemeans(object, group = 1, wave = 1)

profilevariances(object, group = 1, wave = 1)

profilecovariances(object, wave = 1)

Arguments

object

A fitted LPA, multigroup LPA, LTA with continuous indicators, or mixture() model with continuous indicators (latentmix; rows are then the continuous indicators only).

group

Group of a multigroup model (in the order of object$group_levels).

wave

Wave of an LTA (rows are then named by that wave's indicators).

Value

profilemeans() and profilevariances(): an indicator-by-class matrix (with variances = "equal" all columns are equal). profilecovariances(): a list with one indicator-by-indicator covariance matrix per class.

See also

lpa(), parameters()

Examples

data(wellbeing)
# \donttest{
# means, variances and covariances of four wellbeing profiles (full covariances, VVV)
p <- lpa(wellbeing, sleep:lifesat, K = 4, variances = "varying", covariances = "varying")
#> Starting Julia ...
round(profilemeans(p), 2)        # one column per profile
#>          class1 class2 class3 class4
#> sleep      7.18   7.57   5.96   7.65
#> activity   3.50   6.11   3.10   0.93
#> fruitveg   3.03   4.55   2.45   1.98
#> stress     5.66   3.53  10.37   9.14
#> lonely     4.54   3.68   5.76   7.50
#> lifesat    7.09   8.17   5.54   4.78
round(profilevariances(p), 2)
#>          class1 class2 class3 class4
#> sleep      0.43   0.40   0.89   1.33
#> activity   2.05   3.75   1.98   0.39
#> fruitveg   1.34   1.24   0.86   0.82
#> stress     4.26   2.51   6.70   6.62
#> lonely     0.63   0.27   1.17   0.93
#> lifesat    1.15   0.93   2.18   2.21
round(profilecovariances(p)[[1]], 2)   # within-profile covariance matrix of profile 1
#>          sleep activity fruitveg stress lonely lifesat
#> sleep     0.43     0.00    -0.03  -0.33   0.03    0.07
#> activity  0.00     2.05     0.50   0.13   0.09    0.13
#> fruitveg -0.03     0.50     1.34   0.26  -0.03    0.07
#> stress   -0.33     0.13     0.26   4.26   0.34   -0.63
#> lonely    0.03     0.09    -0.03   0.34   0.63   -0.18
#> lifesat   0.07     0.13     0.07  -0.63  -0.18    1.15
# }
